definitions.gloss: Ajinomoto; MSG seasoning; the company that makes it
definitions.explanation: The trade name of the monosodium-glutamate seasoning first sold in 1909, and of the major food company behind it. The name is also used loosely for any MSG seasoning, the way "Hoover" once stood for vacuum cleaners.

examples.japanese: スープに{味|あじ}の{素|もと}を{少|すこ}し{入|い}れる。
examples.english: Add a little Ajinomoto to the soup.

examples.japanese: {味|あじ}の{素|もと}は{日本|にほん}を{代表|だいひょう}する{食品|しょくひん}メーカーだ。
examples.english: Ajinomoto is one of Japan's leading food manufacturers.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{何|なに}を{作|つく}るときでも{味|あじ}の{素|もと}を{振|ふ}りかけていた。
examples.english: My grandmother sprinkled Ajinomoto on whatever she was cooking.

notes:
Literally "the source of flavour." The product grew out of Ikeda Kikunae's 1908 identification of {旨味|うまみ}, the savoury fifth taste.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {味|あじ}の{素|もと}を{振|ふ}る: to sprinkle on MSG seasoning
- {味|あじ}の{素|もと}を{一|ひと}{振|ふ}り: one shake of the seasoning
- {味|あじ}の{素|もと}スタジアム: Ajinomoto Stadium, the Tokyo football ground the company sponsors

CULTURAL CONTEXT:
Older speakers often use {味|あじ}の{素|もと} generically for MSG, while younger cooks are more likely to say うま{味|み}{調味料|ちょうみりょう} (umami seasoning). The company itself is a household name well beyond the seasoning, selling frozen foods, instant coffee, and amino-acid products.
